However, such a clear and convenient formulation does not take any goals other than performance into account. In real life, the agent can have multiple goals and multiple objectives that should be satisfied at the same time. One of the most important goals that is different from performance is safety. Although the definition of RL safety varies from one study to another, in this work, we define safety as the state of being protected from harm or other dangers.
